column1: # Contemporary interlinear gloss over the held-out cipher of the 2 Oct 1719 letter (ff. 5v-6v), read on the images.
# This replaces the rough alignment of pass B (work/pass_b_1719_gloss.tsv), which has misread gloss words
# (apparenza for assistenza, denaro for demerito, che for Re, arrive for animo, intimone for insinuare).
# Only gloss words that are legible and whose groups are clear by position are listed; doubtful glosses are left out
# read_by: V = independent verifier (blind sample 5v.L11-L15 and f. 6r, gloss read before opening solver files);
#          P = packager, 3 Nov 2026 (6v), after the key was frozen.
# groups: the tokens of transcription_1719.txt, in order; ' | ' separates the parts on two lines (lid a+b).
